content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** SFJ gives no performance warranty for the SFJ Services — Article 13 contains only a mutual authority/no-conflict rep and SFJ's funding covenant (13.5), with the rest of the Article running against PB. Section 2.2.2 is a bare compliance covenant with no warranty period or remedy, and Section 13.6.2 disclaims all warranties except those set out in Article 13. That fails every fallback element (software conformance, services duration, repair/replace, refund).

**Cure:** one insertion at Article 13 (new 13.5.1, placed inside the disclaimer's own carve-out so no amendment to 13.6.2 is needed) providing 90-day software conformance to documentation, a 30-day SFJ Services warranty, and repair/replacement or refund remedies — fallback level only, with no added survival, expense, or procedural tails.
